lines.zh: 贴着墙根走，这样影子小。
lines.en: I hug the wall so my shadow stays small.

lines.zh: 八只一起移动，脚步却听不见。
lines.en: Eight of us move, and you hear no steps.

lines.zh: 长廊尽头有光，我绕开它。
lines.en: There's light at the corridor's end; I avoid it.

lines.zh: 爪尖扣住石缝，慢慢往下爬。
lines.en: My claws hook the stone seams as I climb down.

lines.zh: 滴水石在头顶，我踩着它过。
lines.en: Dripstone hangs above; I cross on its ledges.

lines.zh: 我走三步就停下听听。
lines.en: Every three steps I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 同伴在东廊，我在西边绕。
lines.en: My kin are in the east hall; I circle the west.

lines.zh: 地上的浮尘太新，我刚走过。
lines.en: The dust on the floor is fresh; I just passed.

lines.zh: 这层的回音会暴露我。
lines.en: The echo on this floor gives me away.

lines.zh: 我贴着天花板走，倒着爬。
lines.en: I travel the ceiling, climbing upside down.

lines.zh: 荒古的石头缝够宽，正好藏身。
lines.en: The ancient stone gaps are wide enough to hide in.

lines.zh: 脚上的刺刮过石面，很轻。
lines.en: The spikes on my feet scrape the stone, softly.

lines.zh: 我去看看前厅的闸门有没有开。
lines.en: I'll check whether the front hall's gate is open.

lines.zh: 越往里走，我的壳越凉。
lines.en: The deeper I go, the colder my shell gets.

lines.zh: 我把身子压得更低，过那道梁。
lines.en: I flatten lower to clear that beam.

lines.zh: 前面有根断柱，我从后面绕。
lines.en: A broken column ahead; I go around its back.

lines.zh: 我挂在梁上，等脚步声靠近。
lines.en: I hang from the beam, waiting for footsteps.

lines.zh: 雾气在石缝里打转，我不动。
lines.en: Mist eddies in the seams; I stay still.

lines.zh: 八只都不出声，这层就安静了。
lines.en: Eight of us silent, and this floor is quiet.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里卡了块碎石。
lines.en: A chip of stone is stuck in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 我在数滴水石滴水的间隔。
lines.en: I count the intervals between dripstone drops.

lines.zh: 雕纹的石头摸着比别处滑。
lines.en: The chiseled stone feels smoother than the rest.

lines.zh: 有人来过，土上有鞋底的纹。
lines.en: Someone's been here; there are boot prints in the dust.

lines.zh: 我把刺收起来，免得反光。
lines.en: I fold my spikes in so they don't glint.

lines.zh: 这扇门后应该是空的。
lines.en: The space behind this door should be empty.

lines.zh: 我侧着听，墙里有水在走。
lines.en: I listen sideways; water moves inside the wall.

lines.zh: 面甲合上，我的呼吸变闷。
lines.en: The faceplate closes and my breathing muffles.

lines.zh: 天花板上有三道旧抓痕，是我的。
lines.en: Three old claw marks on the ceiling are mine.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我的影子拉长了。
lines.en: You raise a torch and my shadow stretches.

lines.zh: 你走路的声音，比前几个人轻。
lines.en: Your steps are quieter than the last few who came.

lines.zh: 我在数你有几把武器。
lines.en: I'm counting how many weapons you carry.

lines.zh: 你还没看见我，这就对了。
lines.en: You haven't seen me yet; that's exactly right.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到梁上，别抬头。
lines.en: Your torch doesn't reach the beam; don't look up.

lines.zh: 你把背对着门，胆子不小。
lines.en: You've turned your back to the door; brave.

lines.zh: 我在等你的同伴走散。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your companions to drift apart.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块石，是松的。
lines.en: That stone you stepped on is loose.

lines.zh: 你屏住了呼吸，可胸口还在动。
lines.en: You've held your breath, but your chest still moves.

lines.zh: 再看一眼墙上的雕纹，你就懂了。
lines.en: Look once more at the carved wall, and you'll understand.

lines.zh: 甲裂了一道，里面还硬。
lines.en: My shell cracked once; it's still hard beneath.

lines.zh: 你用箭？那对我没用。
lines.en: Arrows? Those do nothing to me.

lines.zh: 摔下来我也不会散。
lines.en: I won't come apart from a fall.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我的壳还能撑。
lines.en: It hurts, but my shell holds.

lines.zh: 八只里少了一只，我听见了。
lines.en: One of the eight is gone; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你砍中了我的关节，有点麻。
lines.en: You hit my joint; it's gone a little numb.

lines.zh: 我退到石柱后面，重整架势。
lines.en: I fall back behind the pillar and reset my stance.

lines.zh: 这点伤，撑得住一次分裂。
lines.en: This wound can still carry one split.

lines.zh: 我的血是凉的，落在石上不冒气。
lines.en: My blood is cold; it doesn't steam on the stone.

lines.zh: 你打我的时候，背后空着。
lines.en: While you strike me, your back is open.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我只看你的手。
lines.en: Set the food down; I'm watching your hand only.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我只等你自己走近。
lines.en: I don't eat that; I wait for you to walk closer.

lines.zh: 那袋东西晃得响，是铁器吧。
lines.en: That bag rattles; iron tools, I'd guess.

lines.zh: 你伸手那一刻，我才动。
lines.en: The moment you reach out, I move.

lines.zh: 诱饵太明显了，摆在正中间。
lines.en: The bait is too obvious, laid dead center.

lines.zh: 在要塞里，没有人喂我。
lines.en: Nobody feeds me inside the fortress.

lines.zh: 你的食物留着，你自己更顶饿。
lines.en: Save your food; you yourself are the meal.

lines.zh: 香味盖不住你身上的汗味。
lines.en: The smell of food can't hide your sweat.

lines.zh: 我不靠近你，等你自己过来。
lines.en: I won't come closer; I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 这块肉放三天，我也不碰。
lines.en: Leave that meat three days; I still won't touch it.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我顺势退进阴影。
lines.en: You bump into me; I slip back into the shadow.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上去，声音很闷。
lines.en: My shell knocks against it with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 地方不够，我们只能贴墙。
lines.en: There's not enough room; we press to the wall.

lines.zh: 你别用手推，刺会划破你。
lines.en: Don't push with your hands; the spikes will cut.

lines.zh: 这一撞暴露了位置，可惜。
lines.en: That collision gave away my spot, a pity.

lines.zh: 退开，我要回梁上去。
lines.en: Back off; I'm going back up to the beam.

lines.zh: 八只堵在门口，谁也过不去。
lines.en: Eight of us fill the doorway; nobody passes.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了一下，刺碰到了石。
lines.en: I sway from the hit; a spike scrapes stone.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块砖松了，小心。
lines.en: That tile under your foot is loose; mind it.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我身上有滴水石粉。
lines.en: Don't lean in; I'm dusted with dripstone.

lines.zh: 我们用爪在墙上划痕，配成对。
lines.en: We pair by the claw marks we scratch on the wall.

lines.zh: 她把卵产在石缝里，很浅。
lines.en: She lays eggs in the stone seam, shallow.

lines.zh: 八只里只有我们两个靠得近。
lines.en: Among the eight, only the two of us stay close.

lines.zh: 我替她守着这条通道。
lines.en: I keep watch over this passage for her.

lines.zh: 交配以后，我们会分开狩猎。
lines.en: After mating, we hunt apart.

lines.zh: 她的甲比我的黑，纹路很深。
lines.en: Her shell is darker than mine, deeply ridged.

lines.zh: 卵孵出来，也会学贴墙走。
lines.en: The hatchlings will learn to hug the walls too.

lines.zh: 别在门口站着，那是我们的路。
lines.en: Don't stand in the doorway; that's our path.

lines.zh: 两对足勾在一起，就是约定。
lines.en: Two pairs of legs hooked together, that's the pact.

lines.zh: 配偶冷了，会靠进我的壳下。
lines.en: When my mate is cold, she tucks under my shell.

lines.zh: 地上那块碎片，有雕纹。
lines.en: That shard on the floor has carvings.

lines.zh: 我把碎石搬开，底下有缝。
lines.en: I shift the rubble; there's a gap beneath.

lines.zh: 这根骨头是上个人留下的。
lines.en: This bone was left by the last one.

lines.zh: 铁片割手，我用爪夹着。
lines.en: Iron cuts skin; I hold it between my claws.

lines.zh: 不捡没用的，太重跑不动。
lines.en: I don't take junk; too heavy to run with.

lines.zh: 我拖了一块石头堵住侧门。
lines.en: I drag a stone over to block the side door.

lines.zh: 同伴掉了片甲，我收起来。
lines.en: A flockmate shed a shell plate; I keep it.

lines.zh: 这里有根绳，我咬断了。
lines.en: There's a rope here; I bite it through.

lines.zh: 发光的东西我不碰，怕是陷阱。
lines.en: I leave glowing things alone; they may be traps.

lines.zh: 东西压在梁下，得两只一起抬。
lines.en: It's pinned under the beam; two of us must lift it.

lines.zh: 你进了中厅，就算进来了。
lines.en: You've entered the central hall; that counts as in.

lines.zh: 火把的光圈一收，我就上。
lines.en: When your torch light shrinks, I move.

lines.zh: 这一层只剩你一个活物。
lines.en: On this floor you're the only living thing left.

lines.zh: 你踩响了两块砖，位置我记住了。
lines.en: You clinked two tiles; I have your position.

lines.zh: 八只都醒了，从梁上下来。
lines.en: All eight are awake, coming down from the beams.

lines.zh: 你先动手，我就有名分了。
lines.en: Strike first and I'll have my excuse.

lines.zh: 你的同伴还在上一层，来不及。
lines.en: Your companions are a floor up; too late.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的铁与汗。
lines.en: Rust and sweat reach me across the hall.

lines.zh: 把火把放下，我可以少费些力。
lines.en: Drop the torch and this will cost me less effort.

lines.zh: 这条路走到头，就是我的地盘。
lines.en: This corridor ends where my ground begins.

lines.zh: 你回头四次，我每次都换梁。
lines.en: You looked back four times; I changed beams each time.

lines.zh: 现在开始，走廊归我。
lines.en: From now on, the corridor is mine.

lines.zh: 我从梁上落，先断你的退路。
lines.en: I drop from the beam and cut your retreat.

lines.zh: 八只围成半圈，留一个口子。
lines.en: Eight of us ring you, leaving one opening.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就绕到侧面。
lines.en: You raise your shield; I go around the side.

lines.zh: 箭射不穿我，别浪费了。
lines.en: Arrows won't pierce me; don't waste them.

lines.zh: 这高度摔不死我，你放心跳。
lines.en: This height won't kill me; feel free to jump.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，你的剑够不着。
lines.en: I crawl along the floor, below your blade.

lines.zh: 等你换手的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you switch hands.

lines.zh: 把同伴分开，再一个个处理。
lines.en: Split the companions apart, then take them one by one.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在肩上有缝。
lines.en: There's a gap in your armor at the shoulder.

lines.zh: 我先撞你的膝，让你跪下。
lines.en: I hit your knee first and bring you down.

lines.zh: 别退到门口，那里也有我们。
lines.en: Don't back toward the door; we're there too.

lines.zh: 这层的光灭了，我就占上风。
lines.en: Once this floor goes dark, I have the advantage.

lines.zh: 前爪扣住你的小腿。
lines.en: My foreclaws clamp onto your calf.

lines.zh: 这一下是刺，不是爪。
lines.en: This one is the spike, not the claw.

lines.zh: 我撞你胸口，力道够把你推倒。
lines.en: I slam your chest hard enough to knock you down.

lines.zh: 咬住手腕，等你松手。
lines.en: I bite your wrist and wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 刺扎进护甲的接缝。
lines.en: A spike drives into the seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 我借落下的势，砸在你肩上。
lines.en: I use the fall's momentum and slam your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一只，挡不住八只。
lines.en: You can block one, not eight.

lines.zh: 打完我就退，别追。
lines.en: I strike and withdraw; don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在膝弯。
lines.en: This bite lands behind your knee.

lines.zh: 我的爪印会留在你甲上。
lines.en: My claw marks will stay on your armor.

lines.zh: 要塞的石门一开，我们八个就位。
lines.en: The fortress gate opens and eight of us take position.

lines.zh: 出生在梁上，脚一松就落下。
lines.en: I spawn on the beam; one slip and I drop.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找阴影。
lines.en: First thing: find the shadow.

lines.zh: 同伴各自散开，各占一段走廊。
lines.en: The others scatter, each taking a stretch of hall.

lines.zh: 我的壳还是软的，得等一会儿。
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I must wait a while.

lines.zh: 荒古的灰尘落在我背上。
lines.en: Ancient dust settles on my back.

lines.zh: 这里的高度刚好，适合伏击。
lines.en: This height is just right for an ambush.

lines.zh: 我把刺立起来，晾一晾。
lines.en: I raise my spikes to let them dry.

lines.zh: 八只都到齐了，可以开始了。
lines.en: All eight are here; we can begin.

lines.zh: 石缝是我的床，也是我的门。
lines.en: The stone seam is my bed and my door.

lines.zh: 甲被烧得发亮，烫。
lines.en: My shell glows from the fire; it's hot.

lines.zh: 这个高度，我落下来就站住。
lines.en: From this height I simply land and stand.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的刺先沉。
lines.en: Water rises and my spikes sink first.

lines.zh: 炸开的石头比我先落地。
lines.en: The shattered stone lands before I do.

lines.zh: 箭弹开了，连印都没留。
lines.en: The arrow glances off without leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 药水在我甲上结成一层膜。
lines.en: Potion beads into a film on my shell.

lines.zh: 要塞里没有吃的，我也习惯了。
lines.en: There's no food in the fortress; I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 雷顺着梁打下来，我贴着地。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the beam; I press to the floor.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石缝可躲。
lines.en: There are no stone seams to hide in the void.
